semiconductor_relevance: High — MAT PLUS CO., LTD. specializes in scrubber systems for the semiconductor industry, focusing on the treatment of flammable and water-soluble gases.
summary: MAT PLUS CO., LTD. has been dedicated to scrubber technology since its establishment in 1995, emphasizing continuous technological innovation and customer-centric services. Their Flameless Catalytic Thermal Oxidation (FCTO) system efficiently treats hazardous gases while minimizing contamination and maintenance needs in semiconductor fabrication environments.
capabilities: Flameless Catalytic Thermal Oxidation (FCTO) systems for gas treatment
High-temperature catalytic treatment for NF3, N2O, and VOCs
Multi-stage wet collection systems for particulate matter
